# Meter Group

Partition one exact shared capacity into ordered named measurements.

## Usage

### Grouped capacity

Partition one shared capacity into ordered named measurements and explicit remaining space.

<ComponentExample component="meter-group" scenario="grouped-capacity" title="Grouped capacity" description="Partition one shared capacity into ordered named measurements and explicit remaining space." :index="0" />

### Zero values

Keep zero-valued categories in order without assigning them visual capacity.

<ComponentExample component="meter-group" scenario="zero-values" title="Zero values" description="Keep zero-valued categories in order without assigning them visual capacity." :index="1" />

### Exact decimal

Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion.

<ComponentExample component="meter-group" scenario="exact-decimal" title="Exact decimal" description="Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion." :index="2" />

### Invalid input

Reject a partition whose exact total exceeds the shared capacity.

<ComponentExample component="meter-group" scenario="invalid-input" title="Invalid input" description="Reject a partition whose exact total exceeds the shared capacity." :index="3" />

## Segment-change example

Each Meter Group item exposes its ratio through `--sectile-meter-group-percentage`. Animate only segment length when the data changes.

```css
[data-scope='meter-group'][data-part='item'] {
  inline-size: var(--sectile-meter-group-percentage, 0%);
  transition: inline-size 180ms ease-out;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='meter-group'][data-part='item'] { transition: none; }
}
```

## API reference

See [Meter Group API](/api/components/meter-group) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

One named group contains ordered, individually named read-only meters; visual track and legend parts add no duplicate aggregate announcement.
